verdict.rationale: CrewAI's Enterprise/AMP API exposes /kickoff, /status/{id} and /resume endpoints that imply some server-side persistence of crew execution state across calls (crewai-docs-56, crewai-docs-57), but there is no documentation of native checkpointing across process restarts/deploys or of integration with a durable-execution engine (e.g., Temporal, Restate). Memory (crewai-docs-5, crewai-docs-50) persists conversational context, not execution state of long-running agents. missing for 10: explicit durable-execution integration or native crash/restart recovery mechanism, documentation of how in-flight tasks survive a process restart, and independent/hands-on verification of resumability.
